description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for IndexedDB onupgradeneeded version migration (v1->v2): retain old store 'users', add new store 'orders', old data survives. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/idb/upgrade_migrate`, and the server-side grader compares it against the Chrome-baked expected answer. The answer is computed only by executing the IndexedDB operation (it is not present in the static resource); the DB name is isolated per attempt via the `db` query param.
title: IndexedDB onupgradeneeded version migration retains old store and adds new store
